'''Jedi Pack''' is the 9th expansion of Star Wars CCG.
It is published by Decipher in 1996 and consists of 10 cards.

This 11-card pack was released as a thank you to players and was distributed for free via an email offer. It contained versions of Han, Leia, Tarkin, and Motti with very limited functionality, but nonetheless allowed players to play with the, at the time, difficult to acquire "main characters."

CardGuide lists 10 cards. Light: For Luck; Han; Leia; Luke's T-16 Skyhopper; Tedn Dahai. Dark: Dark Forces; Eriadu; Gravity Shadow; Hyperoute Navigation Chart; Motti; Tarkin.
